exposure: Low cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) defined as ≤10th centile
outcome: Cesarean birth due to abnormal fetal heart rate pattern
cohort: 281 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and non-anomalous singleton pregnancies
finding: In pregnancies affected by GDM, CPR ≤10th percentile was not associated with a composite of adverse perinatal outcomes but was associated with neonatal hypoglycemia.
